第016章：化神战四合体
华纪56年3月16日，下午，星际战场。
四位合体境强者的围攻已经持续了半个时辰。天狼大帝的天狼剑裂纹密布，蛮荒大帝的双拳血肉模糊，幽冥大帝的黑雾被张德华的神识一次次击散，太虚大帝的古剑剑刃上多了三道缺口。而张德华，除了右拳上一道深可见骨的剑伤，浑身浴血之外，气息依然稳定，战意依然炽烈。
“不可能……这不可能……”天狼大帝喃喃道。他活了十万年，从未见过如此恐怖的化神境。化神四重，战力却堪比合体后期。肉身硬扛合体二重的蛮荒一拳，神识碾压合体二重的幽冥幻术，速度躲开合体三重的太虚剑罡，拳力震裂合体三重的天狼剑。这不是战斗，这是怪物。
“天狼，你的情报有误！”蛮荒大帝怒吼，“这他妈是化神？合体后期也不过如此！”
“少废话，合力一击！”太虚大帝沉声道，“用最强招式，一招定胜负！”
四位合体境对视一眼，同时点头。他们不再保留，将各自压箱底的绝技同时祭出。天狼大帝燃烧精血，天狼剑上的裂纹被血光填补，剑身爆发出刺目的黑芒。蛮荒大帝双拳对撞，拳面上的骨骼碎裂又重组，化作一双漆黑如墨的骨拳，那是蛮族秘术“碎星拳”，一生只能用三次。幽冥大帝化作一团遮天蔽日的黑雾，雾中无数鬼哭狼嚎，那是幽冥星系最强神魂攻击“万魂噬天”。太虚大帝的古剑脱手飞出，化作九柄剑影，结成“太虚九剑阵”，每一剑都蕴含着斩碎星辰的法则之力。
四股合体境的力量汇聚在一起，形成一道直径百丈的能量洪流，向张德华轰去。洪流所过之处，空间崩塌，时间扭曲，一切物质都被碾为虚无。
张德华没有退。灵能双翼在背后展开到最大，金色的灵光与氢弹的毁灭之力在体内融合。他深吸一口气，将化神四重的全部法力、压缩在经脉中的氢弹能量、以及丹田中化神小人的本源之力，全部凝聚在右拳之上。
“华夏——力量！”
一拳轰出。
金色的拳罡与四色的能量洪流在太空中碰撞。没有声音——因为声音无法在真空中传播。但所有人的灵魂都“听”到了那一声巨响，那是能量湮灭时产生的次声波，直接震动着每个人的神魂。
拳罡与洪流的对抗持续了整整十息。十息之内，两种力量在太空中互相吞噬、湮灭、重生。张德华的右臂再次碳化，皮肤剥落，露出金灿灿的骨骼。但他的左拳紧随其后，又是一拳。
“给我——破！”
第二道拳罡加入，能量洪流终于支撑不住，被拳罡从中间撕开。金色的光芒穿过洪流，直接轰在了四位合体境的身上。
天狼大帝被轰飞数百里，胸口再次出现一个焦黑的拳印，鲜血狂喷。蛮荒大帝的双拳骨拳碎裂，双臂无力地垂下，口中鲜血涌出。幽冥大帝的黑雾被金光驱散，真身暴露，浑身焦黑。太虚大帝的九柄剑影被拳罡震碎，古剑断裂成两截，本人倒飞出去，撞穿了一颗小行星。
四位合体境，全部重伤。
张德华站在虚空中，右臂碳化，浑身浴血，但他的腰杆挺得笔直，眼神比任何时候都要明亮。
“化神怎么可能这么强！”天狼大帝的声音在颤抖。
张德华看着他，嘴角微微上扬。

“因为我是华夏军人。”
四位合体境重伤垂死，天狼联合军残部四散奔逃。但张德华没有停手。战争不是比武，没有点到为止。敌人不死，战争就不会结束。
他第一个走向蛮荒大帝。蛮荒大帝靠在破碎的小行星上，双臂垂落，血如泉涌。看到张德华走过来，他的眼中闪过一丝恐惧，但很快被蛮族的倔强取代。
“来啊！老子不怕死！”蛮荒大帝怒吼。
“那你就去死。”张德华抬起左拳，一拳轰在蛮荒大帝的头颅上。
化神四重的全力一拳，加上氢弹能量的余波，直接将蛮荒大帝的头颅打爆。红的血、白的脑浆、金的骨骼碎片四散飞溅。无头的尸体在太空中漂浮了数息，然后被张德华掌心射出的灵能火焰烧成了灰烬。第一个合体境，陨落。
“蛮荒！”太虚大帝悲呼。他和蛮荒大帝相交万年，虽非至亲，也是故友。故友死在眼前，他怎能不悲？
“张德华，你——！”
“你们来打华夏的时候，有没有想过华夏人会死？”张德华转身，走向太虚大帝，“你们的修士杀我华夏战士的时候，有没有想过他们也有父母妻儿？战争是你挑起的，就别怪我心狠手辣。”
太虚大帝张了张嘴，说不出话。他闭上了眼睛。
张德华没有犹豫。右手虽然碳化，但左手还能用。他伸手抓住太虚大帝的元神——合体境修士的元神已经凝实如真人，可以被肉眼看到。太虚大帝的元神在他手中挣扎，但化神四重的力量远超重伤的合体元神。
“华夏，必胜。”张德华轻声说，然后五指用力，将太虚大帝的元神捏碎。
金色的元神碎片从指缝间飘散，如同无数萤火虫在太空中飞舞。第二个合体境，陨落。
幽冥大帝想跑。他的身法最快，伤势最轻，化作一道黑雾向远处遁去。张德华的神识早已锁定了他，一万五千里的感知范围，幽冥大帝无处可逃。他从空间戒指中取出一枚单兵反物质炮——那是专门为对付合体境研发的微型武器，威力虽不如舰载主炮，但足以击杀重伤的合体修士。
“再见了。”
扳机扣动。一道白光射出，精准地击中了数千里外的黑雾。黑雾在白光中湮灭，幽冥大帝的惨叫声在虚空中回荡了不到半息，然后归于沉寂。第三个合体境，陨落。
天狼大帝跪在虚空中，浑身是血，天狼剑断成两截漂浮在身边。他看着张德华一步步走近，眼中满是绝望和不甘。
“本帝……十万年修为……就这么……”他喃喃道。
“十万年，你活够了。”张德华站在他面前，“但你做错了一件事。”

Chapter 016: Transformation into a God and Fighting the Quadruple
It was the afternoon of March 16, 56 BC, on the interstellar battlefield.
The siege by the four Fusion Realm experts has lasted for half an hour. The Heavenly Wolf Emperor's Sirius sword was covered with cracks, the Savage Emperor's fists were bloody and fleshy, the Netherworld Emperor's black mist was dispersed by Zhang Dehua's consciousness time and time again, and the Taixu Emperor's ancient sword had three more gaps on its blade. As for Zhang Dehua, except for a bone-deep sword wound on his right fist, which was covered in blood, his aura was still stable and his fighting spirit was still fierce.
"Impossible...this is impossible..." Emperor Sirius muttered. He has lived for a hundred thousand years and has never seen such a terrifying state of transformation. At the fourth level of divine transformation, his combat power is comparable to that of the late integration stage. The physical body can withstand the wild punch of the second level of fusion, the spiritual consciousness crushes the Netherworld Illusion of the second level of fusion, the speed dodges the Taixu Sword Gang of the third level of fusion, and the power of the fist shatters the Tianlang Sword of the third level of fusion. This isn't a fight, this is a monster.
"Sirius, your information is wrong!" The Savage Emperor roared, "Is this a fucking god? It's nothing more than that in the later stages of integration!"
"Stop talking nonsense and strike together!" Emperor Taixu said solemnly, "Use your strongest move to determine the outcome with one move!"
The four Fusion Realms looked at each other and nodded at the same time. They no longer held back and used their unique skills at the same time. Emperor Sirius burned his essence and blood, the cracks on the Sirius sword were filled with blood, and the sword erupted with a dazzling black light. The Savage Emperor collided with his fists, and the bones on his fists shattered and reorganized, turning into a pair of bone fists as black as ink. They were the barbarian secret technique "Star-Breaking Fist" and could only be used three times in his life. The Netherworld Emperor turned into a black fog that covered the sky and the sun. Countless ghosts were crying and howling in the fog. It was the most powerful soul attack in the Netherworld Galaxy, "Ten Thousand Souls Devouring the Sky". Emperor Taixu's ancient sword flew out of his hand and turned into the shadow of nine swords, forming the "Taixu Nine Swords Formation". Each sword contained the power of the law that could crush the stars.
The four forces of the Fusion Realm gathered together to form a torrent of energy with a diameter of a hundred feet, blasting towards Zhang Dehua. Wherever the torrent passed, space collapsed, time was distorted, and all matter was crushed into nothingness.
Zhang Dehua did not retreat. The psychic wings spread out to the maximum on the back, and the golden aura and the destructive power of the hydrogen bomb merged in the body. He took a deep breath and concentrated all the magic power of the fourth level of the God Transformation, the hydrogen bomb energy compressed in the meridians, and the original power of the God Transformation villain in the Dantian into his right fist.
"China - power!"
Punch out.
The golden fist and the four-color energy torrent collided in space. There is no sound - because sound cannot travel in a vacuum. But everyone's souls "heard" that loud noise. It was the infrasound wave generated when energy was annihilated, which directly shook everyone's soul.
The confrontation between Quan Gang and Hongliu lasted for ten breaths. Within ten breaths, the two forces devoured, annihilated and reborn each other in space. Zhang Dehua's right arm was carbonized again, and the skin peeled off, revealing golden bones. But his left fist followed with another punch.
"Give it to me - break it!"
The second fist gang joined in, and the torrent of energy finally couldn't support it, and was torn apart from the middle by the fist gang. The golden light passed through the torrent and directly hit the bodies of the four in the Fusion Realm.
Emperor Sirius was blasted hundreds of miles away, a blackened fist mark appeared again on his chest, and blood spurted out wildly. The Savage Emperor's fists were shattered, his arms hung down weakly, and blood gushed out from his mouth. The black mist of the Netherworld Emperor was dispersed by the golden light, and his true body was exposed, and his whole body was scorched black. The shadow of Emperor Taixu's nine-handled sword was shattered by the fist, and the ancient sword broke into two pieces. He flew backwards and crashed through an asteroid.
All four of them were seriously injured.
Zhang Dehua stood in the void, his right arm was carbonized, and his body was covered in blood, but his waist was straight and his eyes were brighter than ever.
"How can the Avatar be so strong!" Emperor Tianlang's voice was trembling.
Zhang Dehua looked at him, the corners of his mouth raised slightly.
"Because I am a Chinese soldier."
The four combined realmsDying from their wounds, the remnants of the Sirius Alliance Army fled in all directions. But Zhang Dehua didn't stop. War is not a contest, it does not end at the end. The war will not end until the enemy dies.
He was the first to approach the Savage Emperor. The Savage Emperor leaned on the broken asteroid, his arms hanging down, and blood gushing out. Seeing Zhang Dehua approaching, a trace of fear flashed in his eyes, but it was quickly replaced by the stubbornness of the barbarian.
"Come on! I'm not afraid of death!" the Savage Emperor roared.
"Then you die." Zhang Dehua raised his left fist and punched the Savage Emperor on the head.
The full force punch of the fourth level of God Transformation, coupled with the aftermath of the hydrogen bomb energy, directly blew the head of the Savage Emperor open. Red blood, white brains, and golden bone fragments were scattered everywhere. The headless corpse floated in space for a few breaths, and then was burned to ashes by the psychic flames shot from Zhang Dehua's palm. The first combined state, the fall.
"Barbaric!" Emperor Taixu cried sadly. He and the Manhuang Emperor have known each other for thousands of years. Although they are not close relatives, they are also old friends. How could he not be sad when his old friend died before his eyes?
"Zhang Dehua, you——!"
"When you came to fight against China, did you ever think that the Chinese people would die?" Zhang Dehua turned around and walked towards Emperor Taixu, "When your monks killed my Chinese soldiers, did you ever think that they also have parents, wives and children? You started the war, so don't blame me for being cruel."
Emperor Taixu opened his mouth but was speechless. He closed his eyes.
Zhang Dehua did not hesitate. Although the right hand is carbonized, the left hand can still be used. He reached out and grabbed the soul of Emperor Taixu - the soul of the Fusion Realm monk had become as solid as a real person and could be seen by the naked eye. Emperor Taixu's soul struggled in his hands, but the power of the fourth level of divine transformation far exceeded that of the seriously injured combined soul.
"China will definitely win." Zhang Dehua said softly, and then used his five fingers to crush Emperor Taixu's spirit into pieces.
Golden fragments of soul floated from the fingers, like countless fireflies flying in space. The second fusion state, the fall.
The Netherworld Emperor wanted to run away. His movement was the fastest and his injuries were the lightest. He turned into a black mist and fled into the distance. Zhang Dehua's consciousness has already locked onto him. With a range of fifteen thousand miles, the Netherworld Emperor has nowhere to escape. He took out a personal anti-matter cannon from the space ring - it was a micro-weapon specially developed to deal with the Fusion Realm. Although it was not as powerful as the ship's main gun, it was enough to kill a seriously injured Fusion monk.
"Goodbye."
Trigger pulled. A ray of white light shot out, accurately hitting the black fog thousands of miles away. The black mist was annihilated in the white light, and the screams of the Nether Emperor echoed in the void for less than half a breath, and then fell silent. The third fusion state is death.
Emperor Sirius was kneeling in the void, covered in blood, with the Sirius sword broken into two pieces floating beside him. He watched Zhang Dehua approach step by step, his eyes full of despair and unwillingness.
"This emperor...one hundred thousand years of cultivation...that's all..." He murmured.
"One hundred thousand years, you have lived enough." Zhang Dehua stood in front of him, "But you did one thing wrong."
